newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-BARBARIANS NAME 13 ALL BLACKS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BARBARIANS NAME 13 ALL BLACKS.

text.p: Giant winger Jonah Lomu was named on Wednesday as one of 13 All Blacks in the New Zealand Barbarians side to meet England at Twickenham on Saturday.
The only uncapped players in the side are number eight Taine Randell and winger Joeli Vidiri.

Team - Christian Cullen; Joeli Vidiri, Alama Ieremia, Lee Stensness, Jonah Lomu; Andrew Mehrtens, Justin Marshall; Taine Randell, Michael Jones, Andrew Blowers, Ian Jones, Robin Brooke, Mark Allen, Sean Fitzpatrick (captain), Olo Brown.
